 JUDGMENT This Civil Miscellaneous Appeal has been filed for enhancement of compensation granted by the award dated 07.09.2023 made in M.C.O.P.No.290 of 2020 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Special Sub Judge, No.II, Salem.

sentences.text: He filed the above said claim petition, claiming a sum of Rs.1,78,00,000/- as compensation on account of the injuries sustained by her in an accident that took place on 26.05.2019.

3.The Tribunal, considering the pleadings, oral and documentary evidence, held that the accident occurred due to rash and negligent driving by https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis the driver of the bus bearing Registration No.TN 30 N 1345, belonging to the 5th Respondent- Transport Corporation and directed the 3rd Respondent- Insurance Company as well as the 5th respondent - Transport Corporation to pay a sum of Rs.3,91,733/- each as compensation to the appellant and thereafter to recover the same from the 2nd respondent.
4.Not being satisfied with the amounts awarded by the Tribunal, the appellant has come out with the present appeal seeking enhancement of compensation.

5. Though several grounds have been raised in this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal for enhancement of the compensation, the learned counsel for the appellant restricts his claim with regard to non inclusion of medical expenses incurred towards purchase of artificial limb and other pharmacy bills to the tune of Rs.1,73,584/- which is supported by Ex.P5- Medical Bill and submitted that the compensation may be enhanced by including these expenses.

6. Mr.J.Michael Visuvasam, learned counsel appearing for the 3rd https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis respondent-Insurance Company fairly agreed for inclusion of medical expenses incurred to the tune of Rs.1,73,584/- towards purchases of artificial limb and other pharmacy bills as evidenced through Ex.P5.
7.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the appellants as well as the learned counsel appearing for the 3rd respondent-Insurance Company and perused the entire materials on record.

8. A perusal of the Award passed by the Tribunal would go to show that though Ex.P5 - Medical Bills has been filed before the Tribunal for a sum of Rs.1,73,584/-, the Tribunal has not included the Mrs.Gandhimathi vs K.Elumalai on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/112820853/
2 same and further no reason has been assigned thereof.

On a perusal of Ex.P5-Medical Bills, it is seen that a sum of Rs.1,73,584/- has been incurred by the claimant towards purchase of artificial limb and other medicines and therefore, this Court is of the view that the said expenses can be added while modifying the compensation awarded by the Tribunal under the head Medical Bills.
9.
The amounts awarded by the Tribunal under other heads are just and reasonable and hence, the same are hereby confirmed.
Thus, the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis compensation awarded by the Tribunal is modified as follows:
S. Description

Amount Amount Award confirmed No awarded by awarded by this or enhanced or Tribunal Court granted (Rs) (Rs)
1. 70% permanent 3,50,000/- 3,50,000/- Confirmed disability (70x5000=3,50,000 )
2. Medical Expenses 32,465/- 32,465/- Confirmed (25700+6765=32,4 65)
3. Transportation, 2,00,000/- 2,00,000/- Confirmed Nutrition & Attender charges (at the time of treatment and future transport)
4. Pain and Sufferings 1,00,000/- 1,00,000/- Confirmed 5. Loss of Amenities 1,00,000/- 1,00,000/- Confirmed and Enjoyment of life 6. Damages to 1,000/- 1,000/- Confirmed clothing and articles 7.

Medical Bills NIL 1,73,584/- Granted Total Rs.7,83,465/- Rs.9,57,049/- Enhanced by Rs.1,73,584/-
10.In the result

, this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is partly allowed and the compensation awarded by the Tribunal at Rs.7,83,465/- is hereby enhanced to Rs.9,57,049/- together with interest at the rate of 7.5% per https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis annum from the date of petition till the date of deposit.

The 3rd and 5th Respondents are directed to deposit the entire compensation amount now determined by this Court at Rs.4,78,525/- each, along with interest and costs, less the amount already deposited, if any, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment to the credit of M.C.O.P.No.290 of 2020 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (In the Court of Special Sub-Court No.II), Salem.
